title: Anton Repponen, People Look at Art: the title says the idea twice
note: A photo essay about museum visitors. The title is set in a receipt typeface (Receipt by CakeType) and every line is mirrored in pale grey beside itself, so the type does what the title says: people look at art, art looks back. A thin line drawing of a gallery room and of Matisse's Dance, then the real photo of a man looking at the real painting. Colophon as dotted-leader rows (Built with……Readymag). Readymag Websites of the Year 2025, jury choice. Worth taking: a typographic trick that only makes sense for this one subject.
